name: Taiko no Tatsujin: Rhythm Festival - Namco Game Music Pack
summary:
This DLC is playable in Taiko no Tatsujin: Rhythm Festival game modes like Taiko Mode, Great Drum Toy War and Run! Ninja Dojo.

Namco Game Music Pack contains 5 songs: "SYMPHONIC VALKYRIE", "EAT'EM UP!", "GOING TO LUNATEA", "Boku no→Chikyu, Bokura no Chikyu" and "The arrow was shot".

The songs included in this product may also be available in the Taiko Music Pass.
